Dear Tamween Pharma Distribution,

Per §3.2 of Services Agreement CT-2023-014, this constitutes the ninety (90) day notice that the Agreement will automatically renew for contract year 2026 on 1 January 2026 unless terminated in writing by either party no later than 2 October 2025.

Per §3.3, the 2026 monthly service fee will adjust from the 2025 base of SAR 188,000 by the applicable CPI-linked formula (CPI + 3%, uncapped, compounded per the escalation schedule), yielding an effective 2026 monthly fee of SAR 229,736 (+22.20%).
